text:
Nora L: heads up — trending alert: ap-south edge shows higher TLS handshake retries and session-resumption failures since yesterday's cipherlist enforcement + keystore RBAC tighten. small impact but rising.
Ben K: saw that in dashboards. distribution: session_resumption_fail_rate went from 0.4% -> 7.1% across proxies in ap-south over 12h.
Diego M: any KMS denies in the logs? that often explains ticket unwrap issues.
Nora L: past hour logs include both AccessDenied and InvalidCiphertext from KMS during ticket unwrap. snippet: ```2026-03-22T14:01:12Z WARN proxy/handshake ticket unwrap failed: kms error=InvalidCiphertext key_id=projects/apac/keys/keystore-01 version=2````
AuditBot: KMS Audit: 1789999123 — principal=service-proxy-ap-south attempted kms:Decrypt resource=projects/apac/keys/keystore-01 result=ACCESS_DENIED
Ben K: hmm mismatch between expected key version and unwrap leading to InvalidCiphertext sometimes, and separate AccessDenied events when RBAC denies Decrypt for proxies that don't carry the new provisioning tag.
Security Eng: quick theory: rotation service bumped to v2 keys; some proxies still holding old session tickets encrypted with key v1. RBAC change added condition forcing resource tag team=platform — proxies without tag get AccessDenied on Decrypt. when OldTicket+WrongKey -> KMS returns InvalidCiphertext. both symptoms present.
Diego M: immediate mitigation options? rollback RBAC or temp allow Decrypt to proxy role for keystore resource?
Nora L: prefer less blast: 1) whitelist a short-lived policy exception for service-proxy-ap-south to allow decrypt of keystore key for 3 hours while rotation finishes 2) trigger a forced ticket eviction so old tickets can't be presented and we avoid InvalidCiphertext churn.
Ben K: can we evict without user impact? session evict leads to reconnects but OK for internal east-west. schedule now?
Security Eng: request approved for emergency policy exception scoped to principal=service-proxy-ap-south and resource=keystore-01 with condition expiry. I'll prepare IAM patch and an audit annotation.
AuditBot: emergency IAM change proposal created id iam-exc-1789999130 by @Security Eng. awaiting deploy.
Diego M: I can ship a rolling eviction job to proxies in ap-south to drop TLS session cache and force full handshake. will throttle to 2% at a time. PR infra/sessions#789.
Nora L: please include upgrade of metadata agent to emit key_version field so future diagnostics easier. some proxies failed to report key_version and thus couldn't correlate.
Ben K: noted — metadata agent bump tracked in infra/provisioning#459. also add a smoke test: create a short-lived ticket encrypted with current key and attempt unwrap in staging with both current and older key versions.
Security Eng: after emergency deploy, we should run an org-wide dry-run audit for any RBAC policies that reference kms:Decrypt or kms:AsymmetricDecrypt. rule: surface principals that would be denied by new conditions.
AuditBot: dry-run scheduled 2026-03-23T09:00:00Z UTC. will post report here.
Nora L: emergency IAM change deployed  status?
AuditBot: iam-exc-1789999130 deployed at 2026-03-22T14:15:12Z. exception expires 2026-03-22T17:15:12Z. change logged to audit-iam.
Diego M: eviction job started, job id session-evict-1789999145. first batch 2% proxies. rolling.
Ben K: metrics: session_resumption_fail_rate down to 1.9% after first 10% evictions and exception applied.
Nora L: good. postmortem action items: - add keystore key-version telemetry to proxies - gate RBAC rollouts with a KMS decrypt dry-run + ticket unwrap smoke test - ensure rotation service publishes mapping of key_id -> active_versions to S3 - run canary RBAC changes in apac staging before region rollout
Security Eng: adding to incident board inc-178999 and assigning owners. also will add an automated check: when policy condition references resource tags, fail rollout if >0 principals lack those tags.
Ben K: will take metadata agent PR and the smoke-test automation.
Diego M: I'll handle eviction rollout docs and one-click rollback for session cache evict.
Nora L: thanks. closing alert when metrics stable. keep this thread for the audit report and dry-run outputs.
AuditBot: incident inc-178999 created and linked to incident board. report pending.
